en.name: Sunbird
languages: understands Common but can't speak it

trait.name: Death Throes
entries: When the sunbird dies, it explodes, and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 ({@damage 12d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried. The sunbird's body turns to ash, but an egg is left where the sunbird was.

trait.name: Fire Aura
entries: At the start of each of the sunbird's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage, and flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature that touches the sunbird or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage. The aura also sheds bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light for an additional 60 feet.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The sunbird doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: The sunbird has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sunbird makes two talon attacks.

action.name: Talon
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 18}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the sunbird can't attack another target with that talon. A {@condition grappled} creature takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) fire damage at the start of each of the sunbird's turns.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The angel's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}). The angel can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

trait.name: Angelic Weapons
entries: The angel's weapon attacks are magical. When the angel hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 4d8} radiant damage (included in the attack).

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The angel makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
entries: The angel touches another creature. The target magically regains 20 ({@dice 4d8 + 2}) hit points and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: The angel magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the angel's choice).

In a new form, the angel retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and special senses are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Emrakul fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Emrakul has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Reflective Carapace
entries: Any time Emrakul is targeted by a {@spell magic missile} spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll a {@dice d6}. On a 1 to 5, Emrakul is unaffected. On a 6, Emrakul is unaffected, and the effect is reflected back at the caster as though it originated from Emrakul, turning the caster into the target.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: Emrakul deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Emrakul can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes five attacks: one with its bite, two with its claws, one with its horns, and one with its tail. It can use its Swallow instead of its bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}36 ({@damage 4d12 + 10}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 20}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and Emrakul can't bite another target.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d8 + 10}) slashing damage.

action.name: Horns
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}32 ({@damage 4d10 + 10}) piercing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 4d6 + 10}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of Emrakul's choice within 120 feet of it and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if Emrakul is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Emrakul's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Swallow
entries: Emrakul makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, it has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside Emrakul, and it takes 56 ({@damage 16d6}) acid damage at the start of each of Emrakul's turns.

If Emrakul takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, Emrakul must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of Emrakul. If Emrakul dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 30 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Emrakul makes one claw attack or tail attack.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Emrakul moves up to half its speed.

legendary.name: Chomp (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Emrakul makes one bite attack or uses its Swallow.
